subject: Winfield Health — go-live logistics, owner assignment & tactical checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Customer Success Team <cs@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@winfieldhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Winfield Health — go-live logistics, owner assignment & tactical checklist

Hi team,

Quick handoff: Winfield Health (see Sarah CC'd) signed the SOW yesterday and want to target a staged go-live for 2025-09-15 (pilot cohort of 250 clinicians). Deal details below and a short set of asks so we can kick the post-sign playbook into motion.

Deal summary (short):
- Contract: 12 months, SOW (attached) signed — platform + 3 integrations.
- Initial scope: clinician triage assistant + search embeddings.
- Committed throughput: 120 rps peak for pilot, expected steady-state 30 rps.
- Special terms: 30-day rollback window; Redwood to provide one-week dedicated onboarding support.

Primary customer contacts:
- Sarah Thompson, Dir. of Product Ops — sarah.thompson@winfieldhealth.com (CC)
- They will nominate an infra lead for network whitelisting shortly.

Immediate asks for CS/Onboarding (please confirm owners):
1) Owner assignment for technical kickoff & runbook ownership (we need a single point of contact).
2) Schedule a 60-min kickoff with Winfield + infra (target week of 2025-09-01).
3) Confirm checklist: network allowlist, API keys, sandbox creds, initial prompt set, and evaluation metrics.
4) Review the attached MutualActionPlan_Winfield_v3.xlsx — it has proposed milestones.

Notes: They asked for a minor custom mapping on our events schema (field: patient_id_hash) — flagged legal/compliance already; will require a short tech design call.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOW_Winfield_signed.pdf (signed SOW), MutualActionPlan_Winfield_v3.xlsx

Subject: Re: Winfield Health — go-live logistics, owner assignment & tactical checklist

Thanks Ben — congrats on close. Monica, would you be able to take primary ownership for Winfield technical onboarding? Monica has handled similar pilot cohorts and the integrations work fits her bandwidth for Sept.

Proposed next steps (from CS side):
- Monica = primary onboarding owner (ops + tech contact).
- Tessa = program manager for timelines and customer comms (scheduling, runbooks).
- Internal kickoff: Mon/Tessa/Karthik/Ben to align on scope and blockers — propose Tue 2025-08-26 10:00 PT for a 30-min internal sync.

Questions for Ben before we reach out to Sarah for scheduling:
- Any gotchas in the SOW scope we should flag to CS (custom mapping timeline or security exceptions)?
- Who will own the field mapping design call (sales or product)?

I'll draft an onboarding runbook template and circulate a pre-kick checklist (network allowlist, sandbox links).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben / Karthik. I'm happy to take primary owner. Below is a pragmatic onboarding plan and owners for next two weeks. I'll set up the kickoff calendar invite after Ben confirms stakeholder availability.

Onboarding plan (first 30 days) — owners:
- Primary onboarding owner (Monica Patel): runbook, tech kickoff, integration validation, daily 10:00 sync during week-of-cutover.
- Program manager (Tessa Morgan): scheduling, acceptance criteria tracking, status reports to customer.
- Sales liaison (Ben Carter): escalation + contract clarifications.
- Security/compliance liaison (Karthik Iyer): SOC 2 evidence and any security exceptions.

Tactical checklist (immediate):
- Action 1: Schedule customer kickoff (owner: Tessa) — target windows 09/02, 09/03 mornings ET.
- Action 2: Obtain sandbox creds & API keys (owner: Monica) — request to ops@winfieldhealth.com.
- Action 3: Network allowlist (owner: Andrew/Winfield) — review attached Network_Whitelist_List.csv.
- Action 4: Field mapping call for patient_id_hash (owner: Monica + Winfield product) — 45-min call to define contract.
- Action 5: Upload finalized runbook to Drive and link in HubSpot (owner: Tessa).

Internal note: there is a minor custom mapping ask — recommend we scope as a 2-day effort in pilot and include in acceptance criteria (so billing/rollout expectations are explicit).

Doc links and attachments: I've uploaded a draft runbook to the shared Drive (link in thread metadata). The signed SOW and mutual action plan are attached in Ben's original email.

Monica Patel
